description: The button that applies the report filters form on the loan book report
scenario: Changed button text - applying a status filter narrows the report

source.text: this.applyFiltersButton = healable(page, APPLY_FILTERS, (p) => p.getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply filter', exact: true }));
